text.ms:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Insolvensi (Pemohon bagi
Pendaftaran Penama) 2025.

Pemohon bagi pendaftaran penama

2. Orang yang dinamakan dalam Jadual ditetapkan sebagai pemohon bagi maksud
subperenggan 2G(1)(a)(iii) Akta.

JADUAL

Zulkurnain bin Mohd Yaman
Mohd Syukree bin Aziz

Dibuat 31 Disember 2024
[MdI. 600-3/1/1; PN(PU2)180/JLD.5]

DATO' SRI AZALINA BINTI OTHMAN
Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri
(Undang-Undang dan Reformasi Institusi)

INSOLVENCY ACT 1967

INSOLVENCY (APPLICANT FOR REGISTRATION OF NOMINEE) ORDER 2025

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subparagraph 2G(1)(a)(iii) of
the Insolvency Act 1967  [Act 360 ], the Minister, on the recommendation of
the Director General of Insolvency, makes the following order:

Citation
1. This order may be cited as the Insolvency (Applicant for Registration of
Nominee) Order 2025.

Applicant for registration of nominee
2. The person s named in the Schedule are prescribed as the applicants
for the purposes of subparagraph 2G(1)(a)(iii) of the Act.

SCHEDULE

Zulkurnain bin Mohd Yaman
Mohd Syukree bin Aziz

Made 31 December 2024
[MdI. 600-3/1/1; PN(PU2)180/JLD.5]

DATO' SRI AZALINA BINTI OTHMAN
Minister in the Prime Minister's Department
(Law and Institutional Reforms)
